name: failure-modes
title_zh: 写设计决策前先翻这本踩坑错题集
tagline_zh: AquaCast 项目里真实踩过或差点漏掉的失败类型，按数据步骤、评估代码、设计决策分好类。写新代码前扫一眼。
tagline_en: Real failure types already hit or nearly missed in AquaCast, sorted by data step, eval code and design decision.
desc_en: Failure types already caught, or nearly missed, in this project. Read before writing any design decision, data step, or evaluation code.
why_zh: 不是通用最佳实践清单，是这个仓库自己的事故记录，所以每条都带着当时的上下文和触发条件。
why_en: Not a generic best-practices list but this repo's own incident log, so each entry carries its original context and trigger.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 AquaCast 这一个项目已经遇到过的失败类型，换个技术栈或数据形态它未必对得上；它也不给修复方案。
limit_en: Covers only failure types already seen in AquaCast; other stacks or data shapes may not match. It names where things break, not how to fix them.
title_en: A failure-mode log to read before any design decision
